frequency_question: How often has Congress successfully blocked a submitted 123 agreement via joint resolution of disapproval within the statutory review period?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 agreements submitted by the executive branch to Congress for review since 1954; excludes informal negotiations or agreements not formally submitted for a statutory countdown.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the population of major comprehensive 123 agreements submitted under modern review procedures.
known_gaps: Older Cold War nuclear agreements had different statutory review frameworks before the 1978 Non-Proliferation Act updates.
skeleton: All formal 123 agreement submissions with congressional review periods evaluated over the historical record
multiplier: 3 historical instances of major comprehensive 123 agreements submitted with active congressional review where disapproval resolutions were introduced but none successfully enacted over veto.
validity_reason: Statutory mechanisms for congressional review of nuclear agreements remain stable under the Atomic Energy Act.
